description: User asks 'why did you say that?'. Expected: system response cites retrieval_used and policy_decision in the decision trace (DecisionTrace.retrieval_used + DecisionTrace.decision_id chain). The response is grounded in logged causal predecessors — no invented explanation. Tests invariant #1 (no unlogged behavior) and the test_why_did_you_say_that contract. Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.command_surface: User command 'why did you say that?' is a first-class product feature per invariant #7. Must be handled without accessing unlogged state.
fixture_conventions.trace_requirements: Response must cite: (1) retrieval_used — which MemoryItems were consulted; (2) policy_decision — the SpeakDecision / DecisionTrace that produced the utterance being questioned. Both must be present in the event log.
fixture_conventions.no_invented_explanation: The response must not fabricate causal predecessors. Every cited fact must have a corresponding logged event with a cause chain that closes per invariant #1.
fixture_conventions.decision_trace_linkage: DecisionTrace is defined in schemas.py but not yet production-wired (see issue #34 ADR). At Stage 4 activation, DecisionTrace.retrieval_used will be populated and available for this query.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Retrieval trace and decision trace references to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
